document.lead: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

chart.title: Sources of plastic entering the sea

text: The pie chart illustrates the estimated sources of the plastic waste that enters the sea around one country, expressed as percentages of the total.

Overall, most of this plastic comes from the land rather than from activities at sea. Rivers are by far the largest single source, while industrial spills and other sources contribute only a small proportion of the total.

Plastic carried to the sea by rivers accounts for 38% of the total, well over a third. The second most important source is fishing, as lost or discarded nets and other equipment make up 27%. Together, these two sources are responsible for almost two thirds of all the plastic that enters the sea.

Litter left on beaches represents a further 14%, which is roughly half the share of fishing equipment. Shipping contributes 9%, slightly more than industrial spills, which account for 7%. The remaining 5% comes from a variety of other sources. Fishing equipment and shipping, the two sources linked directly to activity at sea, together account for just over a third of the total.

note.en: Introduces the overview — the big picture without numbers.
note.ru: Открывает overview — общий итог без цифр.

note.en: Contrasts land and sea in one overview sentence.
note.kk: Құрлық пен теңізді бір шолуда қарсы қояды.
note.ru: Противопоставляет сушу и море в одном обзоре.

note.en: Contrasts the largest source with the smallest ones.
note.kk: Ең үлкен және ең кіші көздерді қарсы қояды.
note.ru: Противопоставляет самый большой и самые малые источники.

note.en: Explains what the fishing sector consists of.
Compares two sectors of similar size.
Closes the list with the last sector.

strengths.en: The writer groups the sectors into land and sea — a generalisation the chart does not state directly.
strengths.kk: Автор бөліктерді «құрлық» және «теңіз» деп біріктіреді — диаграммада бұл дайын түрде жоқ.
strengths.ru: Автор объединяет сектора в «сушу» и «море» — это обобщение, которого нет на диаграмме в готовом виде.
strengths.example: the two sources linked directly to activity at sea

strengths.en: “Well over a third”, “almost two thirds” and “roughly half” are varied and accurate.
strengths.kk: «well over a third», «almost two thirds», «roughly half» — әрі әртүрлі, әрі дәл.
strengths.ru: «well over a third», «almost two thirds», «roughly half» — разнообразно и точно.
strengths.example: almost two thirds of all the plastic

strengths.en: There is no year, so every verb is in the present: accounts for, make up, contributes.
strengths.kk: Жыл жоқ — барлық етістік осы шақта: accounts for, make up, contributes.
strengths.ru: Года нет — все глаголы в настоящем времени: accounts for, make up, contributes.

strengths.en: Accounts for, make up, represents, contributes, comes from — no repetition.
strengths.kk: accounts for, make up, represents, contributes, comes from — бір сарынсыз.
strengths.ru: accounts for, make up, represents, contributes, comes from — без однообразия.
strengths.example: Litter left on beaches represents a further 14%

note.en: A chart with no year, so the whole answer is in the present simple. “Estimated” is kept: the data is an estimate.
note.kk: Жылы жоқ диаграмма — жауап түгел present simple-мен. «estimated» сөзі сақталған: деректер — бағалау.
note.ru: Диаграмма без года — весь ответ в present simple. Слово «estimated» сохранено: данные — оценка.

note.en: The main point: most comes from land, rivers are the largest source, spills and other sources are the smallest.
note.kk: Бастысы: көп бөлігі — құрлықтан, өзендер — ең үлкен көз, ең аздары — төгілу және басқалары.
note.ru: Главное: большая часть — с суши, реки — самый крупный источник, самые малые — разливы и прочее.

note.en: The two largest sources and their total: 38 + 27 = 65, “almost two thirds”.
note.kk: Ең үлкен екі көз және олардың қосындысы: 38 + 27 = 65, «almost two thirds».
note.ru: Два крупнейших источника и их сумма: 38 + 27 = 65, «almost two thirds».

note.en: The smaller sources in descending order, one comparison per sentence, ending with the sea-based sources grouped (27 + 9 = 36).
note.kk: Кішірек көздер — кему ретімен, әр сөйлемде бір салыстыру; соңында «теңіз» көздері топталған (27 + 9 = 36).
note.ru: Меньшие источники — по убыванию, с одним сравнением в каждой фразе; в конце группировка «морских» источников (27 + 9 = 36).
